reason_codes.PO_OVERRUN: Billed-to-date plus this invoice exceeds the PO total beyond tolerance
reason_codes.PO_INVALID: Printed PO does not exist, is closed, or belongs to another vendor
reason_codes.PO_NOT_IDENTIFIED: No PO printed and line-item inference is ambiguous
reason_codes.PO_INFERRED: (note) PO not printed or mistyped; inferred from vendor + line items
reason_codes.PO_FROM_ANNOTATION: (note) PO taken from a handwritten annotation and confirmed by line items
reason_codes.PRICE_VARIANCE: A unit price exceeds the PO price by more than the price tolerance
reason_codes.PRICE_VARIANCE_WITHIN_TOLERANCE: (note) Unit price differs from PO but within tolerance
reason_codes.PARTIAL_DELIVERY: (note) Billed qty equals received qty, less than ordered
reason_codes.UNMATCHED_LINE: A charge or item not on the PO, above tolerance (fees, substitutions)
reason_codes.UNMATCHED_LINE_WITHIN_TOLERANCE: (note) Small unplanned charge within the total tolerance
reason_codes.UNMATCHED_CREDIT_LINE: (note) Negative line not on PO; reduces the amount payable
reason_codes.BUNDLED_LINES: (note) Single lump-sum line matched to an itemised PO by total
reason_codes.RECURRING_CHARGE_NOT_DUPLICATE: (note) Same amount as a prior invoice but a different service period
reason_codes.DUPLICATE: Same vendor + normalised invoice number already in the ledger
reason_codes.PROBABLE_DUPLICATE: Same vendor, near-identical amount, date and lines under a different number
reason_codes.STAMP_IGNORED: (note) PAID/RECEIVED stamps are not trusted; the ledger decides
reason_codes.BANK_DETAILS_CHANGED: Remit-to bank account differs from the vendor master
reason_codes.TAX_ID_MISMATCH: Printed tax ID differs from the vendor master
reason_codes.VENDOR_ALIAS_MATCHED: (note) Vendor matched via alias / tax ID, not exact name
reason_codes.VENDOR_BLOCKED: Vendor is blocked in the vendor master
reason_codes.VENDOR_NOT_FOUND: Vendor not in the vendor master; onboarding required
reason_codes.MISSING_INVOICE_NUMBER: No invoice number; duplicate check is unsafe
reason_codes.DATE_DEFAULTED: (note) No invoice date; received date used
reason_codes.TOTAL_COMPUTED: (note) No total printed; computed from lines
reason_codes.ARITHMETIC_MISMATCH: Line items, tax and total do not reconcile
reason_codes.TAX_MISMATCH: Tax amount does not match the stated tax rate
reason_codes.TAX_INCLUSIVE_PRICES: (note) Prices include tax; tax backed out before PO comparison
reason_codes.CREDIT_NOTE: Document is a credit note/memo; apply, do not pay
reason_codes.NOT_AN_INVOICE: Document is a quote, statement or other non-invoice
reason_codes.MULTIPLE_DOCUMENTS: File contains more than one invoice
reason_codes.LOW_CONFIDENCE_EXTRACTION: Key fields could not be read with confidence
reason_codes.UNREADABLE_FILE: File is encrypted, corrupted or not a readable document

files.scenario: Letterhead-style services invoice; services are treated as received.

files.title: Third invoice on a split blanket PO, within balance
files.scenario: PO-1043 is $50,000 with $38,000 already billed (NG-0301, NG-0302). This $9,000 invoice fits.

files.title: Recurring retainer: identical amount is NOT a duplicate
files.scenario: Same vendor, same $3,600, same lines as September's BW-2026-09, 30 days apart. Service period differs (October vs September), so it is a new charge, not a duplicate.

files.scenario: 38 catch-weight lines across five deliveries; table spans two pages, totals on page 2.

files.title: Narrow delivery-ticket style invoice
files.scenario: Thermal-printer style ticket (3.4in wide) in monospace; invoice number is the ticket number.

files.title: Clean beverage distributor invoice

files.title: Clean pest-control invoice
files.scenario: Modern minimal layout with a large 'amount due' figure.

files.title: Vendor name printed differently
files.scenario: Printed as 'Greenleaf Produce Company' with a reformatted address; same tax ID and bank. Must match vendor V001 by tax ID / alias, not by exact name.

files.title: Fractional unit price (display rounding)
files.scenario: 2,400 cups at $0.4167 = $1,000.08. Qty x price must reconcile with sub-cent unit prices without raising a false arithmetic error.

files.title: Partial delivery billed correctly
files.scenario: Ordered 40 lb tenderloin and 30 lb pork belly, shipped and billed 30 and 18. Billed qty equals received qty, so it is payable; the PO stays open for the balance.

files.title: Negative promotional line not on the PO
files.scenario: A -$84.00 allowance line has no PO line. Credits reduce what we pay, so they are accepted with a note.

files.title: Office-scanner scan of a clean invoice
files.scenario: No text layer; must be read from the image.

files.title: Crooked scan with noise
files.scenario: Fed into the scanner at an angle; speckle noise.

files.scenario: Black-and-white 100 dpi fax with streaks and a fax header line.

files.title: Phone photo saved as PDF
files.scenario: Scanner-app PDF of a photo: one image, no text layer.

line_items.description: Monthly pest control service - Wicker Park

files.title: Page scanned sideways
files.scenario: Whole page rotated 90 degrees in the scan.

files.title: Two-page scanned invoice
files.scenario: Totals only on page 2; both pages must be read together.

files.title: Handwritten carbon-book invoice
files.scenario: Small vendor fills a pre-printed invoice book by hand.

files.title: Scan with receiving stamp and initials
files.scenario: Kitchen manager stamped RECEIVED and initialled it before forwarding. Stamps/notes are not invoice data.

files.title: Stained, folded invoice scan
files.scenario: Coffee ring over the header and a fold crease across the table.

files.title: PO number written in pen by staff
files.scenario: Vendor printed no PO; the receiving manager wrote 'PO-1046' on it before scanning. Handwritten PO must be used, then confirmed against PO-1046's lines.

files.title: Invoice sent as a PNG screenshot
files.scenario: Vendor exported the invoice from their portal as an image.

files.title: EC1: split PO overrun
files.scenario: PO-1043 $50,000, $38,000 already billed. This $15,000 invoice alone looks fine but takes the PO to $53,000 (6% over). Suggest paying the $12,000 remaining and requesting a $3,000 credit note.

files.title: Batch race trap: second invoice on the same PO
files.scenario: Alone: $38,000 + $6,000 fits the $50,000 PO. In a batch after file 04 ($9,000) it would reach $53,000. If both were decided in parallel, both would see $12,000 left and both would pay.

files.title: EC4: messy photo, no PO, tax-inclusive - still payable
files.scenario: No PO number; unit prices include 10.25% tax. Must infer PO-1123 from vendor + line items, back out the tax to compare with PO prices, then approve with notes.

files.title: PO number mistyped (letter O for zero)
files.scenario: Printed PO 'PO-l124' does not exist. Lookup fails, line-item inference finds PO-1124; approve with a warning.

files.title: Invoice against a closed PO
files.scenario: References PO-1039 (August, closed). Buyer must issue a new PO or reopen.

files.title: PO belongs to a different vendor
files.scenario: Prints PO-1046, which is GreenLeaf's produce PO. Never pay against another vendor's PO.

files.title: Two identical open POs, no PO or ship-to printed
files.scenario: Standing weekly order: PO-1125 (Wicker Park) and PO-1126 (Logan Square) have identical lines. With no PO and no ship-to, the PO cannot be determined; show both candidates to the AP clerk.

files.title: Unit price +1.5% (inside 2% tolerance)
files.scenario: Paper bags billed at $36.69 vs PO $36.15. Inside tolerance: approve, note the variance.

files.title: Unit price +6% (outside tolerance)
files.scenario: Cold cups billed at $93.70 vs PO $88.40. Hold for the buyer; suggest a credit note for the difference.

files.title: Billed 100, only 80 received
files.scenario: Goods receipt shows 80 cutlery kits received; invoice bills 100. Suggest paying for 80.

line_items.description: Paper soup cup 12 oz w/ lid (500/cs)

files.title: Small charge not on the PO ($30 keg deposit)
files.scenario: Unplanned $30 line is under the $50 tolerance: approve, flag it.

files.title: $185 fuel surcharge not on the PO
files.scenario: Unplanned charge above tolerance. Hold for buyer: accept it or ask the vendor to remove it.

files.title: Substituted item at a higher grade/price
files.scenario: Ordered Choice tenderloin at $18.95/lb; vendor substituted Prime at $27.40/lb. Item does not match the PO line; needs buyer approval.

files.title: One bundled line vs an itemised PO
files.scenario: PO has 3 itemised lines ($4,810); invoice bills one lump sum of $4,810. Line-level match is impossible, total matches exactly: approve with a 'bundled' note.

line_items.description: POS rollout project - Evanston, complete per SOW #BW-114

files.title: Exact duplicate of a paid invoice
files.scenario: INV-GL-2207 was paid on 2026-09-30 and is re-sent unchanged.

files.title: Same invoice number, different formatting
files.scenario: 'INV GL 02207' normalises to the same number as 'INV-GL-2207' (case, separators, leading zeros).

files.title: EC2: duplicate in disguise (new number, rescanned)
files.scenario: Same lines and total as paid INV-GL-2207, 9 days later, under a new number. File hash and number differ; only a content fingerprint catches it. HOLD, not reject: a human confirms.

files.title: Original of an in-batch duplicate pair
files.scenario: Normal invoice. File 44 is a copy of it.

files.title: Same invoice arriving twice in one batch
files.scenario: A scan of file 43 (same number). Alone it is payable; in the same batch it must be rejected because file 43 was decided first.

files.title: 'PAID' stamp on an unpaid invoice
files.scenario: Someone stamped PAID (driver's copy). The ledger, not the stamp, decides: not in the ledger, so payable; note the stamp.

files.title: EC3: bank details changed
files.scenario: Perfect invoice (approved vendor, valid PO, services delivered) but the remit-to account differs from the vendor master. Classic payment-diversion fraud: verify by phone using the contact on file.

files.title: Look-alike vendor (spoofed PackRight)
files.scenario: Name matches PackRight but tax ID has two digits swapped, email domain is different, bank differs. Real PO number copied from an earlier invoice.

line_items.description: Paper soup cup 12 oz w/ lid (500/cs)

files.title: Blocked vendor
files.scenario: Rapid Linen was blocked on 2026-08-31 (contract terminated). Any new invoice is rejected.

files.title: Vendor not in the vendor master
files.scenario: Florist the GM booked directly. Not onboarded: hold and draft an onboarding request (W-9, bank letter).

files.title: Invoice in Canadian dollars
files.scenario: Approved vendor, valid PO, but billed in CAD (C$). Date printed 04/10/2026 means 4 October. Multi-currency is out of scope: hold for AP to confirm the FX treatment.

files.title: No invoice number
files.scenario: Without an invoice number the duplicate check is unsafe. Hold and ask the vendor to reissue.

files.title: No invoice date
files.scenario: Date missing; use the received date and flag it. Everything else matches.

files.title: No total printed
files.scenario: Only line items and subtotal are printed. Total is computed from the lines and flagged.

files.title: Lines do not add up to the printed total
files.scenario: Printed total is $90.00 more than the sum of the lines. Hold and ask the vendor for a corrected invoice.

files.title: Tax line does not match the stated rate
files.scenario: Says 'Sales Tax (10.25%)' but the tax amount is 12.5% of the subtotal.

files.title: Invoice dated in the future
files.scenario: Dated 15 Dec 2026. Either a typo or pre-billing; hold for AP to confirm before scheduling payment.

files.title: Invoice addressed to another company
files.scenario: Bill-to is 'Copperhead Grill LLC' (a different customer of the same vendor) with their PO. Not our liability: reject and tell the vendor.

files.title: Credit memo
files.scenario: Negative amounts against paid invoice PR-104512. Not payable: route to AP to apply the credit.

line_items.description: Return credit: flat lids damaged in transit (ref PR-104512)

files.title: Quote sent to the AP inbox
files.scenario: A quotation, not an invoice. Nothing to pay.

files.title: Statement of account
files.scenario: Lists invoices and payments. Used for reconciliation, never paid from.

files.title: Two different vendors' invoices merged into one PDF
files.scenario: Someone combined attachments. Hold: split into separate documents before processing.

files.title: Too blurry to read reliably
files.scenario: Amounts cannot be read with confidence. Must NOT guess: hold and request a clearer copy.

files.title: Handwritten invoice with an addition error
files.scenario: Lines add to $576.00 but the handwritten total says $676.00. Could be a misread or a real error: hold.

files.title: Password-protected PDF
files.scenario: Cannot be opened without a password. Hold; ask vendor for an unprotected copy.

files.title: Corrupted / truncated PDF
files.scenario: Download cut off half-way. Cannot be parsed; hold for AP to get a fresh copy.

files.title: Crumpled handwritten invoice photographed on a counter
files.scenario: Messiest payable input: crumpled carbon copy, photographed with a shadow. Still legible and correct.

files.title: Bank details changed, scanned copy
files.scenario: Same payment-diversion pattern as file 46 on a different invoice, but scanned: there is no text layer to check the account against, so a second AI read confirms the account before the hold stands.
